summary: Keep Codex seats available after retryable provider stream disconnects

replay.detail: No replay cursor, transcript or delivery ledger format changes. Existing completion evidence still fences the next turn.

schema.detail: No database schema, public claim shape or client contract changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: A Codex system error proven to end a retryable connection turn projects to idle with reason connection, allowing the incarnation to receive more work. The same turn's final generic other error preserves its typed retryable connection evidence. Standalone non-retryable and typed fatal errors still end the incarnation.

downtime.detail: No coordinated downtime or added startup work. Running seats need the normal driver update to receive the fix.

manual.detail: No configuration or manual graph repair is required.

recovery.detail: No historical claims are rewritten. The installed Codex 0.160.1 app-server accepted and completed a new turn on the same thread after a reproduced stream disconnect and systemError, so no thread replacement is added.
